formula_name: Observed epidemiology aggregation from direct observed edges.
purpose: Compute observed prevalence from observed evidence rows.

formula_name: Trait/environment evidence aggregation using weighted log-odds.
engineering_assumptions: hardcoded evidence weights and bounded strength
constants: weights default=0.50, clamp floor=1e-6; max_strength=0.90; min_strength=0.20; strength_divisor=10.0

formula_name: Bayesian-style prevalence update from prior and evidence aggregate.
purpose: Blend prior and evidence prevalence with strength, then apply interaction delta.
empirical_inputs: MAT-1001 output + MAT-1002 output + interaction edges
engineering_assumptions: Bayesian naming without explicit likelihood model
constants: strength clamp [0,1], probability clamp [1e-6,1-1e-6], prior fallback=10.0; bayesian_scale=1.0
boundary_conditions: final output floored at 0.0; no upper clamp
missing_data_behavior: observed 0 triggers prior fallback 10.0 in production call path

purpose: Quantify observed-estimated agreement via relative error.
engineering_assumptions: epsilon stabilization with no confidence-interval semantics
boundary_conditions: obs=0 and est=0 -> agreement=100; obs=0 and est>0 -> 0
missing_data_behavior: operates even when MAT-1001 had NO_EVIDENCE

formula_name: Confidence from evidence depth, study breadth, and agreement quality.
empirical_inputs: edge counts + citation counts + MAT-1004 output
constants: denominator floor=1e-6; agreement_weight=0.26; agreement_weight=0.30; evidence_denominator=20.0; evidence_weight=0.43; evidence_weight=0.45; observed_multiplier=1.5; study_denominator=10.0; study_weight=0.25; study_weight=0.31
missing_data_behavior: counts default to zero and score still computed

formula_name: Novelty scoring and emerging concern detection.
purpose: Measure positive observed-estimated gap scaled by confidence.
mathematical_expression: novelty = max(0, P_est-P_obs)*(C/100); emerging = [P_obs<=o_max and P_est>=e_min and C>=c_min]
missing_data_behavior: missing upstream evidence propagates via upstream outputs

formula_name: Priority ranking from prevalence burden, certainty, and novelty.
engineering_assumptions: flooring agreement influence and multiplicative cascade
boundary_conditions: agreement scale lower-bounded; no explicit upper clamp

purpose: Estimate spread-based uncertainty and confidence interval bounds.
mathematical_expression: sigma = stddev(non_observed_values); f = max(f_min, 1-C/100); U = sigma*f; L=max(0,P_est-U); H=max(L,P_est+U)
engineering_assumptions: uncertainty floor based on confidence transform
missing_data_behavior: missing non-observed values collapse stddev to 0
